in_marathi.name: Shoriful
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of Joy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shoriful हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shoriful is derived from the Bengali language and means 'Bringer of Joy'. This name is a combination of the words 'Shori' which means joy and 'ful' which means full or complete. It is a unisex name that is often given to babies born in the Bengali community and is considered to be a beautiful and meaningful name.
